issue.title: Info::is_complete() - does it only wait on Version to be complete?
issue.body:
Docs say:
```
bool dronecore::Info::is_complete() const
Tests if this Version object is fully populated from hardware.
```
But I suspect that `Product` is also waited on.

comments.body: Yes, product is from the same mavlink message, so the docs are wrong.

@julianoes Hope this is the right way to do update - just merge into develop based on develop.

FYI When #135 is merged, also need to update docs to build on top of https://github.com/dronecore/docs/pull/47

issue.title: Info add vendor product 118
issue.body:
This updates the api reference and guide for new `Info::Product` struct (and changes in `Info::Version`). Ie it is the docs that match this update: https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/pull/118

It may need further revision when https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/132 is discussed.
